text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- A former president of Banco Totta e Acores, Alipio Dias, was invited by Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres to become the chief organiser of the Expo 1998 World Fair in Lisbon. The reply of Dias, who was replaced as head of Totta by Luis Champalimaud last week, was not known.
- Tourism in Portugal set to grow this year, Economy Minister Augusto Mateus said.
- Former BTA president Alipio Dias could succeed Antonio Cardoso e Cunha as chief organiser of the Lisbon Expo 1998 World Fair.
- Uncertainty over final 1996 results of Banco Totta e Acores is weighing on the bank's share price.
- Banco Totta e Acores shares have dropped below the privatisation price of 2,630 escudos.
